items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jelly himself didn't put any words. [INTERVIEWEE] No, no he didn't.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because later on, maybe somebody did put a word, but I don't remember.
Jelly himself didn't put any words.
No, no he didn't. It was a nice number. Then of course, that number, I used to get that number mixed up with the old Junkman Blues. Lucky Roberts wrote that.
